subject: platform/pages
professional: a senior technical SEO / static-site engineer who runs a 7,000-page generated site; first questions: is every indexable page in exactly one sitemap at the URL it is served from, do canonicals agree with sitemap locs, are noindex pages kept out, are feeds and llms.txt derived from the same source as the pages, does the build give the same bytes twice, and would the tests notice if a URL went missing?

evidence.correctness: Ran `node platform/pages/build.mjs --out=<scratch> --base=https://marisstella.app/` (about 5 min): 3574 pages got nav, 7612 got share tags, exit 0. Ran `node platform/pages/check.mjs --dist=<scratch>`: 'looks publishable: 1331 products, 45 category pages, 7613 pages, no dead links'. Independent recomputation with my own Python script (python -I, not the author's code): (1) sitemap.xml is a valid sitemapindex of 1332 entries; I parsed sitemap-hub.xml plus all 1331 per-venture sitemaps: 7552 <loc> values, 7552 unique, one host, and every loc resolves to a file on disk (index.html, or page.html for the extensionless URL) with 0 missing; (2) of those 7552, 0 are noindex and 0 have a canonical different from the loc; (3) every index.html NOT in a sitemap is either noindex (feedback, lab, lab/handoff, engineering) or a noindex paginated /writing/page/N/ (59 pages), i.e. the omission is deliberate and the page says so; (4) catalog.json lists 1331 tools, no duplicate slugs, equal to the number of top-level dirs with a sitemap.xml and to check.mjs's product count, and a superset test against ventures/*/index.html found every source venture with an entry page in the catalog; (5) all 192 llms.txt links (177 unique) resolve to built files; feed.xml parses as Atom with 22 entries and per-entry published dates that vary (not stamped with build time); (6) 0 duplicate <title> across 1331 tool pages, 0 missing meta description, 0 missing H1, every JSON-LD block parses. Findings: 454 of 1331 titles exceed 70 characters (max 110, median 65), so Google will truncate them; only 11 of 3574 venture-sitemap URLs carry <lastmod> in this shallow clone (by design, see lastmod.mjs header: shallow-boundary dates are dropped, CI checks out 3000 commits; I could not recompute the CI value here). Sitemaps and canonicals agree everywhere I looked, so correctness is 3; I did not render pages in a browser (the seven browser checks were not run), so not 4.
evidence.completeness: Checked what README.md says the site does: builds every browser venture into one deployment with a hub (yes, 1331 tools, 45 category pages), generates per-venture sitemaps from published pages (yes), robots.txt, llms.txt/llms-full.txt, feed.xml, catalog.json, search-index.json, manifest/sw/offline, 404 (all present in dist), check.mjs gate (ran, passes), writing/blog, research pages, lab, stories, compare pages, share cards (3991 drawn), embed offer, saved bids (all appear in the build log). The seven browser checks (journey, sweep, contrast, roundtrip, presets, highlight, sideways) were not run here (need Playwright and 20-30 min), so they are unverified by me. The README's own 'Why this exists' says '33 tools at the time of writing': stale by 40x, but the build does what the section means.
evidence.verification: Ran `cd platform/pages && node --test '*.test.mjs'` (about 10 min wall, in the background): tests 1453, pass 1451, fail 1, skipped 1. The failure is writing.test.mjs:254 'no committed post is over the title budget without a seo_title': it names 2026-11-07-what-a-pilot-certificate-says-about-regret.md and 2026-11-07-chatter-process-damping-is-a-low-speed-effect.md as over budget with no clean cut, i.e. a real content lint on main is red (the test works; the content is wrong). Mutations seeded and reverted (git checkout, tree clean): M1 lastmod.mjs `if (boundary.has(hash)) continue;` -> `if (false && ...)`: lastmod.test.mjs 2 failed (caught). M2 build.mjs renderHubSitemap About entry replaced by a duplicate of the hub URL: build.test.mjs/generated-pages/check suite 2 failed ('every page the site serves is listed in some sitemap' and the exact hub-sitemap list test) (caught). Both caught by tests that assert on what the build writes, not on mocks. Not scored 4 because the browser checks are nightly, not a merge gate, and a full local run takes 10 minutes.
evidence.craft: Read build.mjs structure (12,334 lines in one file, 61,917 lines across the directory's .mjs files), lastmod.mjs, renderSitemapIndex/renderHubSitemap/renderVentureSitemap (build.mjs:10987-11090), writing.test.mjs. Good: sitemaps are generated from what shipped (the comment explains the 70-of-186-pages bug it prevents), pure render functions are exported and tested, lastmod omits dates it cannot trust rather than faking them, a determinism test exists. Defects: build.mjs is a 12k-line monolith with a 5-minute build, which makes review and local iteration hard; renderHubSitemap is a long chain of hand-concatenated `<url>` strings with no lastmod and no XML-escaping helper (safe today because slugs are [a-z0-9-], but a post slug with & would produce invalid XML); the build takes `--base` from argv by string scanning with no validation of a trailing slash (the code concatenates `${baseUrl}sitemap-hub.xml`, so a base without '/' silently yields broken URLs).
evidence.claims: Checked claims against files: 'no dead links' (check.mjs ran and agrees with my own sitemap-resolution check); 'a page is listed because it shipped' (verified, 0 missing); lastmod 'harmless when omitted' (true by design, but it means a shallow build ships no change signal). Stale or unbacked: README 'Why this exists' says 33 tools at the time of writing (1331 built); README claims the seven browser checks as part of verification but I could not confirm they pass today and they run nightly, not on merge; README describes `cd platform/pages && node --test "*.test.mjs"` as 'what CI runs' yet one test is red on main today. The directory has many undocumented modules relative to the README (about 80 .mjs files).
evidence.fitness: Walked the job of an owner shipping the catalogue: build, check, deploy via portfolio-pages.yml, crawlers fetch robots.txt then sitemap.xml index then 1332 child sitemaps. The output is crawlable and consistent. Friction: a 5-minute build and 10-minute test run on a starved cloud container; titles over 70 characters on a third of tool pages; 1331 tiny per-venture sitemaps (about 3 URLs each) rather than a few larger ones is legal but needlessly many fetches for a crawler; no lastmod on the 3,978 hub URLs.
evidence.domain: Compared with the sitemaps.org protocol (index of up to 50,000 sitemaps, urlset up to 50,000 URLs: 3978 and 1332 are well under), Google's guidance (canonical should match sitemap URL, noindex pages excluded, lastmod only when accurate) and llms.txt convention: all followed. Departures a technical SEO would flag: titles beyond roughly 60 to 70 characters get truncated (454 pages); no lastmod on hub URLs and almost none on shallow builds; per-venture sitemaps fragment the index; no hreflang needed. No structured-data validation was run against Google's Rich Results test (not reachable here).

defects.what: The platform/pages test suite is red on main: two committed posts are over the title budget with no seo_title and no clean cut, so the README's 'what CI runs' command fails.
454 of 1331 tool pages have a <title> longer than 70 characters (max 110), which search results truncate; tool titles are not held to the budget that posts are.
defects.where: platform/pages/build.mjs (tool title assembly; see writing.mjs TITLE_BUDGET for the post-only limit)

defects.what: README says '33 tools at the time of writing' (1331 built); stale counts undermine the 'finished' claim.
renderHubSitemap emits no <lastmod> and interpolates slugs into XML without escaping; --base is not validated for a trailing slash.
build.mjs is a 12,334-line single file with a 5-minute build, hard to review or test in isolation.

verdict: The builder does what it says on the dimension I could recompute: from a fresh 5-minute build, my independent script found 7552 unique sitemap URLs, every one resolving to a built file, none noindex, every canonical equal to its sitemap loc, every unlisted page deliberately noindex, a catalog of 1331 tools equal to the directory count, and llms.txt and feed.xml links all live; the author's own check.mjs agrees. Tests are strong (1451 of 1453 pass and both seeded sitemap/lastmod mutations were caught by tests asserting on real output), but the suite is red today on a content lint (two posts over the title budget), the README is stale in places (33 tools vs 1331) and the monolithic 12k-line build.mjs is a craft concern. Third of tool titles exceed 70 characters. It does not meet the bar only because claims is 2 (stale README claims, 'what CI runs' command failing); correctness and verification are 3. The seven browser checks were not run, so rendering, accessibility and calculator behaviour are unaudited here. Scores are the state before any fix.
